description: The free Authorization Exposure Review: a readable Markdown review of which CI steps can change real systems (deploys, publishes, migrations, infrastructure applies) without an approval gate that can stop them, with the exact fix for each and what the review cannot see. Same analysis as atlasent_evidence_gap_report, written for a person. Read the repository's .github/workflows/*.yml files and pass each one's path and full text as `workflows`. Offline and read-only: no network call, no API key. Show the returned `markdown` to the user as is.

gate_actions.description: Optional `uses:` values that are your own AtlaSent gate wrappers.

workflows.description: Every workflow file to review. Omitting files leaves gaps unreported.

content.description: Full text of the workflow file.

name: atlasent_exposure_review
title: Authorization Exposure Review (free, readable)
